To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) we describe a simple method for the detection of CSN3 alleles in rabbit; (ii) we show that the CSN3 alleles are not fixed in rabbit populations, but that they are polymorphic; (iii) we show that CSN3 alleles have been created by recombination events; and (iv) we demonstrate that CSN3 allele frequencies differ between wild and domestic populations.
we have developed a new, easy and fast method to distinguish the three CSN3 alleles (A, B and C) in rabbits.
